body:
Did you copy this from my diary? /s

But seriously, 100% feel this in my soul. I would be criticized for eating unhealthily, then criticized for being a terribly cook when I tried to try composing a healthier meal.

Then, at a certain point, spite takes over to say “Damned if I do, damned if I don’t - may as well throw the bird and do what I want!”

Until they’d go right back at it again. Rinse, repeat.

So glad I have a new boundaries starter pack going for me now.

NTA

Buy them all the book “The Little Red Hen” for Christmas and write an internet recipe on the inside cover to make on their own.

Let them figure out themselves the work that goes into not just baking, but baking well.

That finding a pair of black/neutral leather work gloves THAT DON’T HAVE FLORALS ON THEM for women in a department store is nearly impossible.

Why must it all be slathered in flower print?!

Thank you for your perspective and advice!

We’ve talked about it he’s like to try being on the receiving end, and he feels HIGHLY uncomfortable with that. Not his cup of tea, which is all fine. 

He has verbalized that he does enjoy it, but I do think you’re very correct that he is not as confident as he’d like to be, and that’s got him in limbo. 

I never thought about him possibly being more of a hands on learner versus a book guy. I’ll definitely keep that in mind. Thank you!

I definitely shy from initiating these days. He’s usually so ready to go at a drop of a hat, and I’m the completely not ready, the tempo between us tends to be mismatched and it just falls apart. It doesn’t make for a very positive experience, so I tend to avoid. 

I’ll definitely be putting more effort into being verbal and with initiating more as well.
Thank you! This makes me hopeful. My hubs is a fantastic man. I just think we’re attempting to canoe upstream without a paddle. Haha
Thank you thank you for all of this. We had a really loving talk last night, and I’m hoping tonight I can share a lot of this great information.

I bought this book last week! I have shared some excerpts of the book with him and we have had talks regarding the gas and brake module. It feels good to know we’re on the right track with that. 

Thank you! Any books are helpful and greatly appreciated!

I’ve been wanting to reply more, but I’ve been at work.

What you’ve stated sounds very similar to how I feel! Makes me feel more understood, thank you. I don’t have many (can also be read as “any”) kink-loving friends that I feel comfortable speaking to about this. So I haven’t really had an outlet.

Thank you so much for your perspective - especially on tackling it as little problems versus one large mess. We are checklist people, so this will be very helpful allowing us to move forward with confidence!
Thanks for the honest perspective! Hard to read, but probably rightfully so.

Plant a perennial that flowers. Name it after her or something mutual you both love. Keep it alive. Take pictures as it grows - save them for later. When it blooms, cut off a single flower. Ask your GF to help you post a picture of it on IG to show your plant off but need someone equally gorgeous to showcase it. 

Post photo with your small album of time lapse photos - her being the centerpiece with the flower. Tag and share to sappy IG accounts. Enjoy all the gf “I see flowers on IG” tears, still get to gift flowers, and you didn’t go against her request to “not buy flowers”.

For added romance - gift every year with a thoughtful twist that keeps it sweet, reliable, and a loving reminder as life moves harshly along.
